answer: What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The pearl holds work receipts rather than names, so the mesa of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
